title: Split screen for 2, 3 and 4 players (DPC Split Screen 0.2.0-dev4, DPC 0.9.177-dev41)
intro: About 10 minutes. Frame generation OFF (upscaling is fine). You on keyboard and mouse, then 2-4 controllers (you can hold them yourself). The plan switches the layouts itself; the layout options are also in the Test settings box. If a view goes black or anything breaks, press End and tell Claude.

probes.split: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and (S.active and 'ON' or 'off') or 'not loaded'
probes.kind: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.kind or '') or ''
probes.views: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; local n = 0; for _ in pairs(S and S.views.ex or {}) do n = n + 1 end; return n
probes.errs: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and S.st.errors or 0
probes.lasterr: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.st.last_error or '') or ''
probes.paused: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.st.suspended_by or '') or ''
probes.menu: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.menu_open) or ''
probes.npl: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local n = 0; for _ in pairs(D and D.R.npl_gone or {}) do n = n + 1 end; return n

steps.text: SPLIT 5. Frame generation off. Start co-op (Ctrl+F6, player 2 holds L3 + R3). Press End once it splits.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout ~= 1 then S.cfg.layout = 1; S.save() end

steps.text: 1/6 TWO PLAYERS. Cards at the bottom of each player's own half; bars only inside the half that sees the character; no game nameplate stretching across the line. Walk near the line, look both ways. Press End.
2/6 MENU. Open the pause menu, look (no lines over it), close it. The split should stay. Press End.
3/6 THREE ACROSS. A third controller holds L3 + R3. Three views across. Look at all three, then press End.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout3 ~= 2 then S.cfg.layout3 = 2; S.save() end

steps.text: 4/6 THREE IN A GRID. Now a 2 x 2 grid; the fourth quarter shows the party from above. Press End.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout3 ~= 3 then S.cfg.layout3 = 3; S.save() end; if S and S.cfg.spare ~= 2 then S.cfg.spare = 2; S.save() end

steps.text: 5/6 FOUR PLAYERS. A fourth controller holds L3 + R3: 2 x 2 grid. Then open and close the pause menu ONCE (last time this crashed). Press End if it survived.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout4 ~= 1 then S.cfg.layout4 = 1; S.save() end

steps.text: 6/6 FOUR ACROSS. Four narrow views. Then end co-op (Ctrl+F6): one normal view again? Press End and tell Claude what you saw.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout4 ~= 2 then S.cfg.layout4 = 2; S.save() end
local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.layout ~= 1 then S.cfg.layout = 1; S.save() end; S.cfg.layout3 = 1; S.cfg.layout4 = 1; S.cfg.spare = 2; S.save()
